title: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS002
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles
- Project is a concentrated solar power facility
- Piping installation subcontractor responsible for all pipe lines and components
- Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards
- The contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Field welds for HTF service piping must receive 100% radiographic examination.
- 5% of all other services' welds will be examined using UT with Shearwave and Phased Array modes.
- All carbon steel pipe spools for specified systems must be internally cleaned by the Subcontractor.
- Subcontractor is responsible for installing all piping components, supports, and field fabricated piping.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Subcontractor must supply specific materials and fittings for piping installation.
- Pressure tests required before insulation application, with Abener Teyma representative witnessing.
